_comment: The web gallery's catalog: every entry here becomes one page under site/<dir>/.
`dir` must be a directory under apps/ -- tools/build-web.cjs asserts that, so a
renamed demo fails loudly here instead of quietly vanishing from the site.
`nativeOnly` is the ONE field that marks a demo as unbuildable for the browser.
It is not a convenience switch: the native-shader demos draw through
Context3DNative (GLSL ES 3.00 -> SPIR-V -> MSL), and the WebGL2 arm of that
channel does not exist yet -- the compiler already refuses `--features
native-shader` with `--target wasm`. Listing the reason (rather than dropping
the demo) is the point: a visitor should see that the demo exists and why it is
not here, not silently miss it (AGENTS.md 1.5 -- never degrade quietly).
